body:
Extract the existing review, teaching, and Study-command delivery/check-receipt algorithms into explicit factories. Current facades retain adapter registration and their public interfaces, with their existing clients, stores and evidence callbacks injected.

Focused review, teaching, command and operation-status regressions passed (172 tests), including inert import/construction checks. Browser typecheck passed. This is a draft pending independent architecture and correctness review; assembled/browser acceptance belongs to the delivery owner.
